default.name: 后端-基础设施 (PG/Redis/MinIO)
commands: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis minio minio-bootstrap && echo '✅ 基础设施已启动 (postgres:5436, redis:6379, minio:9000)'

default.name: 后端-业务服务 (Core/API/Worker/Scheduler)
commands: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop core-service api-gateway ai-worker scheduler 2>/dev/null; docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml rm -f core-service api-gateway ai-worker scheduler 2>/dev/null; docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --build core-service api-gateway ai-worker scheduler && echo '✅ 业务服务已启动 (api-gateway:8002, core:8100)'
